attributes.label: Suction Power
attributes.description: Maximum suction force (measured in Pa) determining how effectively the robot picks up debris, pet hair, and fine dust across floor types.

attributes.label: Navigation & Mapping
attributes.description: The sensor technology and algorithm used to map the home and plan efficient cleaning paths (e.g., LiDAR, vSLAM, gyroscope, random bounce).

attributes.label: Self-Emptying / Auto-Empty Base
attributes.description: Whether the dock automatically empties the dustbin into a larger bag or container, and how many days of debris it can hold before manual emptying is needed.

attributes.label: Battery Life & Runtime
attributes.description: How long the robot can clean on a single charge, and whether it supports auto-recharge-and-resume for larger homes.

attributes.label: Mopping Capability
attributes.description: Whether the robot includes a mopping function, how it applies water (vibration, pressurized, fixed pad), and whether the mop auto-lifts on carpet.

attributes.label: Obstacle Avoidance & Climbing
attributes.description: The robot's ability to detect and navigate around objects (cables, shoes, pet waste) and the maximum threshold or step height it can climb over.

attributes.label: App Control & Smart Home Integration
attributes.description: Quality of the companion app (scheduling, zone cleaning, no-go zones, maps) and compatibility with voice assistants and smart home platforms.

attributes.label: Noise Level
attributes.description: How loud the robot operates during cleaning cycles, typically measured in decibels (dB), including availability of a quiet or night mode.

attributes.label: Filtration & Allergen Control
attributes.description: The type of filter used (HEPA, multi-layer) and its effectiveness at trapping fine particles, allergens, and pet dander.

attributes.label: Pet Hair Performance
attributes.description: How well the robot handles pet hair, including brush design (tangle-free, rubber rollers) and suction tuned for fur pickup.

attributes.label: Floor Type Adaptability
attributes.description: How well the robot transitions between and performs on different surfaces such as hardwood, tile, low-pile carpet, and high-pile carpet.

attributes.label: Dustbin Size & Maintenance
attributes.description: The onboard dustbin capacity, ease of emptying and cleaning, and overall maintenance burden including brush and filter upkeep.

attributes.label: Price / Value
attributes.description: Price, budget fit and overall value

clusters.label: Fully Hands-Free Home Cleaning
clusters.description: Buyers who want maximum automation with minimal intervention — they prioritize self-emptying bases, long runtime, and smart scheduling so the robot runs itself completely.

clusters.label: Pet Owner
clusters.description: Buyers with dogs or cats who need powerful suction, tangle-free brushes, HEPA filtration, and reliable daily pickup of fur and dander.

clusters.label: Hard Floor & Mopping Enthusiast
clusters.description: Buyers with mostly hard floors (tile, hardwood) who want a vacuum-mop combo that scrubs effectively and automatically lifts the mop pad on rugs.

clusters.label: Allergy & Air Quality Sensitive
clusters.description: Buyers or household members with allergies or asthma who prioritize HEPA filtration, sealed dustbins, and quiet operation for frequent daily runs.

clusters.label: Smart Home Integrator
clusters.description: Tech-savvy buyers who want precise LiDAR mapping, granular app controls (room-level zones, no-go lines), and deep integration with Alexa, Google, or Matter ecosystems.
